Project record: the page's existence is evidenced by this repository, not by a government source. Nothing on that page has been implemented (flag F53).

rows.label: Explicit answer to 'is that a state or local law?' in the forefront of the executive summary
rows.value: Published: LIC-11 to LIC-13 on the Executive Summary, Q-22/Q-23 on Questions & Answers, PRC-10/PRC-11 on the step-by-step page, LOC-26 to LOC-28 on Local Law and ST-18 to ST-20 on State Law - answer: LOCAL (SF Ord. No. 265-20, added Sec. 37.15, effective January 18, 2021; small buildings from March 1, 2023), while the 2023 state law (SB 567) amended the Civil Code caps and just-cause rules and imposes no rent-board filing for an increase
rows.notes: Each of those rows links the ordinance text, the City news item, the Board of Supervisors attachment and the Civil Code sections.
